records.our_prose: Aim for roughly one inch of water per week from rain plus irrigation during active growth, applied deeply and less often rather than in frequent shallow doses; established plantings tolerate less. Deep, infrequent watering encourages deeper roots and keeps foliage dry.

records.our_prose: Zinnias flower the same year you plant them, usually about two months after sowing. There is no waiting year. Plant in spring and you will have flowers from summer until the first frost.

records.source_context: This low-maintenance, heat- and drought-tolerant, colorful annual is a must for the garden. Its showy, yellow or orange flowers bloom from summer until the first frost and make excellent cut flowers. Plants are compact and bushier than standard varieties.
